summary: Memory and writing workbenches plus bounded prompt tools. Everything reads and writes through the existing productivity namespace and assistant route; no new IPC channels, contracts, dependencies or CSS files.

requires: useStore() from src/ui/store (status, loadError, reload, state, settings, api, productivityApi, productivity, productivityError, applyProductivity, refreshProductivity, toast)
productivityApi.apply (portability import applies ops one by one)
optional: productivityApi.forgetHistory (privacy section, already handled by MemoryControls)
states: loading (status loading or sidecar not yet read)
disconnected sidecar: notice + chat clearing only

requires: useStore() (status, loadError, reload, state, settings, api, mutate, toast)
optional: api.documentsChoose + documentsSave + documentsDiscard (captain API v2.4): mounts the DocumentImport panel; otherwise the panel says 'Document import is not connected'. Also exported: DocumentImport, localDocumentsBridge, DocumentPreview, DocumentsBridgeLike (structural twins of documentsBridge/ApprovedDocumentPreview; captain may swap imports on integration).
states: note deleted elsewhere (text kept, Save as new note)

screens.props: { input: { text: string; selection?: string; noteId?: string; noteTitle?: string }; onInsert?: (text: string, mode: 'append'|'replace-selection') => void }
requires: useStore() (api, state, productivity, settings, cloudConfigured, toast, reload)
optional: api.chatStreamStart + api.onChatStream + api.chatStreamCancel (streamed reply with Stop; falls back to api.chat when absent)
guarantees: Nothing is sent until the user presses Send to assistant.
The textarea shows the exact text that will be sent; the user may edit it.
Reply text is whatever the route returned, bounded to 20000 characters in the panel; the chat history remains the source of truth.
Sources are only app-owned notes, tasks and checkpoints, cited as [kind:id].

exports: parsePortable(raw, {prod, capsules, noteIds?, taskIds?}, now?) -> {ok, problems, ops, counts, exportedAt?}
backendAdditions.note: Renderer-side pure functions bundled with the UI (same pattern as search helpers). Import applies the returned ProductivityOps through the existing validated productivityApply channel; no new IPC.

keyboard.note: Handled by onKeyDown on the page root; the captain should check they do not collide with global shell chords (Alt+1..0 view shortcuts are untouched).

reducedMotion: Each page root carries data-motion="reduced|full" from Windows prefers-reduced-motion OR settings.reduceMotion. The streaming cursor gets data-cursor="static" under reduced motion. No animation is defined by this module; the captain may key CSS off these attributes.
optionalCssHooks: [data-cursor="blink"] (a blink keyframe if desired; nothing is required)
navIntegration: Add two views to src/ui/nav.tsx / App.tsx mounting <MemoryWorkbench/> and <WritingWorkbench/>. MemorySearch onNavigate for 'note' results could open WritingWorkbench with initialNoteId. No API, contract, preload or backend change is needed.
